method_paragraph: Expected-DTI emitter. Treat the emitter, not the probability surface, as the primary object: emit on a 1-px 3x3 local-maximum skeleton of a label-free surface, exclude a 3.5 px collar around every mapped trace, and set support size to 3.3x the truth-cell count. Justification is the published distance-weighted Tversky index (alpha 0.2 FP, beta 0.8 FN, 300 m triangular kernel): a missed truth cell costs 4x an over-prediction, so a fixed 37,654-dot budget caps recall, and a greedy top-N on a catalogue-trained surface is absorbed by the catalogue collar even though the competition truth is off-catalogue by construction.

promotion_rule: promote only if HOLDOUT-DTI exceeds the retained repository best (0.152718, gems57-pooled-hide-v2, seed 20) on both draws, the paired gain CI excludes zero, the leakage canary stays <= 0.90, and the file is not a duplicate under the like-for-like rule.

expected_primary_failure_mode: more support means more false-positive mass; the optimum may be broad and the plateau flat, in which case the transferable quantity is the ratio, not the absolute count
